concreteAmendment.name: Workspace-registration membership in the existing LRU
concreteAmendment.interface: Retain registeredResource(ctx, resource, through). Its workspace branch performs the existing context-binding check, then consults one additional historyIndex kind keyed by WorkspaceID.
concreteAmendment.valueAndProof: Cache only the found boolean and existing checksummed covered-prefix metadata. Populate it after the existing complete authoritative workspace search succeeds, not merely after observing one workspace_registered record. Preserve the full search's decoding/error behavior.
concreteAmendment.validity: Use the existing historical-entry rule: the search's exact complete prefix or the current accepted prefix, with coverage and checksum validation. An arbitrary intermediate prefix or an earlier prefix cannot borrow a later answer.
concreteAmendment.publicationAndInvalidation: A completed cold fill is inserted only while history coverage still equals its captured prefix. Every accepted workspace_registered effect invalidates the affected WorkspaceID before advancing coverage. A decoding failure during optional invalidation conservatively clears acceleration and leaves the authoritative query to return its existing error; it must not manufacture absence or introduce a cache-only refusal.
concreteAmendment.fallback: Missing, disabled, evicted, oversized, stale, malformed or detectably corrupt acceleration uses the existing full authoritative workspace search.
concreteAmendment.authorityBoundary: Registration remains evidence, not permission. Do not cache workspaceReady. Current origin/context binding, grants, task restrictions and an open matching root scratch remain checked in their existing phases. A cached registration must not make a closed scratch usable.

concreteAmendment.name: Warm existing source-record entries from fully accepted commits
concreteAmendment.interface: Reuse historyIndex.putSource/source and sourceRecords. Feed them actual ledger.Record values already obtained by the authoritative reader during successful commit acceptance.
concreteAmendment.eligibleMetadata: The existing private-revision, scoped-private-revision and task-description source records, plus already-consumed artifact-source records with body references. No arbitrary unknown-family payload caching and no schema5 support is authorized.
concreteAmendment.keyAndProof: Keep the existing source sequence key, instance/colony isolation, record identity and complete-commit first/last bounds. A hit requires the entire source commit to be within the requested prefix and accepted coverage. Preserve type, binding, revision, slot, mode, byte count, body-reference and task-description checks.
concreteAmendment.publication: Warm only after all acceptance checks and effects for that complete commit succeed. Cover both ordinary refresh publication and the existing direct live-review installation. Never warm from draft preparation, rejected groups, a partially processed commit or unacknowledged data.
concreteAmendment.storage: Use the existing copied/encoded metadata representation and shared accounting. Do not retain a whole reader commit backing array while charging only one selected record. Serialization or admission failure simply leaves the entry uncached.
concreteAmendment.fallback: Eviction or invalid proof returns to the unchanged batched segment-aligned source reader. Positive immutable late fills retain the existing complete-commit/prefix rules; mutable or negative fills gain no such exception.

concreteAmendment.name: Reuse the authoritative own-commit read for scoped acknowledgement
concreteAmendment.interface: Factor the existing refresh callback's complete-commit validation/install/publication into a private helper shared by refreshLocked and the contiguous scoped acknowledgement path. It may return the commandMatch decoded from that same accepted commit.
concreteAmendment.eligiblePath: Only a nonduplicate Submit receipt whose First equals the still-locked projection frontier plus one may use the shortcut. Read its exact numeric interval through the existing scan/Reader, require exactly the expected complete commit/range, and validate the actual command ID, submission digest and scoped family.
concreteAmendment.installation: Run the existing reducer checks on the authoritative commit and install it once. Reuse its decoded match for the acknowledgement instead of performing refresh followed by another findCommand scan over that same receipt interval.
concreteAmendment.preservedEffects: Keep duplicate-ID checking, all family effects, maxCommand, reviewFloor from actual envelope times, scratches, identity/association publication, cache invalidation and final p.through publication. No successful acknowledgement follows a reader, range, decoding, reducer or close error.
concreteAmendment.fallback: Duplicate receipts, gaps, prior installation or an ineligible range retain the existing refresh and exact-interval receipt lookup behavior. Do not reconstruct an authoritative receipt from the caller's draft or assume Submit's hot index replaces agents' duplicate detection.
concreteAmendment.commandBoundary: This does not authorize seeding a global command-search answer from one observed command. findCommand retains its (after, through] semantics, duplicate detection, complete-search fills, F0 invalidation and late-fill exclusion.
concreteAmendment.reviewPath: Preserve the existing direct live-review optimization and its already-performed bounded read. Use that accepted commit for source warming/publication; do not reread immutable witnesses or retain a plan across an unlock.
concreteAmendment.costLimit: The existing Reader may still decode the containing segment prefix for a bounded interval. This amendment removes redundant reads and nested metadata searches; it does not make that reader seek directly to a record or promise scan-free ordinary work.

sharedSafetyRequirements: The one LRU remains capped at 256 entries and 8 MiB charged retained metadata, with bounded container overhead. This is not a total-RSS guarantee. No second inventory or lifetime map is permitted.
Whole-commit acceptance precedes accelerator publication. Failed or partial acceptance cannot publish successful lookup proofs, receipts, effects or a covered frontier.

Service.mu remains the outer lock where both locks are needed. The history mutex spans neither I/O nor acquisition of Service.mu. Release it before callbacks or other service work; do not recursively lock it while warming sources.

Preserve all preparation, current-authority, CAS, pre-submit, scope-gate, reservation, retry/wait and acknowledgement phases. Caller cancellation after a durable commit retains existing completion ownership.

Acceleration damage loses acceleration, not committed facts. Authoritative fallback errors remain errors. Preserve historical prefixes, exact receipt intervals, duplicate occurrences and unsupported-version behavior.
Keep S3 fresh object/Markdown observations and all transcript/current-head fences unchanged. Cached ledger metadata is never fresh filesystem-health evidence.

workspace: A missing workspace answer must not survive its later valid registration; later metadata must not appear in an earlier-prefix query.
A warm registration must not bypass wrong context/origin, denied or revoked authority, or a closed/missing matching root scratch. Refusal must append nothing and create no extra hold or charge.
Discarded, evicted and detectably damaged workspace entries must reproduce authoritative outcomes, including real authoritative errors.
sources: Exercise sources warmed by actual accepted replay and live publication, not solely hand-inserted cache entries.
Preserve exact source identity and complete-commit prefix exclusions, rejected-group nonpublication, copied-value isolation and truthful fallback after damage/eviction.
Existing wrong-type/sequence/binding/slot/size/reference and review-rights regressions must remain effective; add only genuinely uncovered cases.
acknowledgement: A contiguous own commit returns its exact durable receipt and installs/charges once; reopen and retry reproduce it without another effect.

An intervening commit or duplicate winner takes the correct fallback. Changed-input reuse remains a conflict. A corrupt or malformed authoritative acknowledgement interval must not be accepted from prepared drafts.
Retain existing command-occurrence, negative-tail versus broader-query, cancellation, completion-failure, projection-fence and Close-draining behavior.
